## Summary

A brief, one-sentence description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed Design

Describe the proposed solution. Include any relevant:
- New C/Rust functions or types
- ABI changes (if any)
- Configuration flags
- Impact on existing behaviour

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why did you prefer this one?

## Additional Context

Links to related issues, papers, or prior art that informed this request.
